title: Dem Status Override
source_docs: AUTOSAR Blockset/Classic Platform/Basic Software/Diagnostic Event Manager (Dem)/Dem_Status_Override.md
text: Override an event to simulate and verify behavior; {EventID} sets the event, {Test Failed} Indicates the result of the most recently performed test, {Test Failed this Operation Cycle} Indicates whether a diagnostic test has reported a failure during the current operation cycle, {Pending DTC} Indicates whether a diagnostic test has reported a failure during the current or last completed operation cycle, {Confirmed DTC} Indicates whether a malfunction was detected enough times to warrant that the DTC should be stored in long-term memory, {Test Not Completed Since Last Clear} Indicates whether a test has run and completed since the last time a call was made to ClearDiagnosticInformation, {Test Failed Since Last Clear} Indicates whether a test has failed since the last time a call was made to ClearDiagnosticInformation, {Test Not Completed This Operation Cycle} sets the test not performed during the current operation cycle and {Warning Indicator Requested} Indicates the status of any warning indicators associated with a particular DTC. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Test Failed
params.values: Indicates the result of the most recently performed test Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Test Failed this Operation Cycle
params.values: Indicates whether a diagnostic test has reported a failure during the current operation cycle Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Pending DTC
params.values: Indicates whether a diagnostic test has reported a failure during the current or last completed operation cycle Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Confirmed DTC
params.values: Indicates whether a malfunction was detected enough times to warrant that the DTC should be stored in long-term memory Clear (default) | Set

params.name: Test Not Completed Since Last Clear

params.name: Test Failed Since Last Clear

params.name: Test Not Completed This Operation Cycle
params.values: Test not performed during the current operation cycle Clear (default) | Set

params.values: Indicates the status of any warning indicators associated with a particular DTC Clear (default) | Set
